scope: File specifications and embedded/associated file views, reviewed against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 text. File path strings retain bytes; only UF, Desc and date strings use the shared PDF text-string decoder. AF is an association view, not a profile validator or a content activation request.

requirements.status: implemented for inert library views and bounded payload reads
requirements.gaps: collection and encrypted-payload models, MIME/date/associated-file conformance validation, streaming extraction, authoring and CLI/host annotation and AF/RF selection remain open. Catalog CLI/host/viewer listing and extraction are implemented separately. Names/URLs never cause IO; permission flags remain a host policy distinct from stream authentication.

requirements.status: explicit bounded library/facade, CLI and protocol 1.10/viewer Size/CheckSum comparison; hosted validation pending
requirements.gaps: Whole-buffer payload decoding; date/MIME/profile/content validation and authenticity assessment are outside this operation.
requirements.rule: Compare declared Size with the actual uncompressed length and declared CheckSum with MD5 over fully decoded and decrypted embedded bytes. An absent declaration is not a match. Mismatches remain observations and never modify the source. Password/filter/limit failures cannot become successful checks. The CLI emits complete schema-1 check JSON before returning exit 1 for a mismatch.

requirements.status: bounded library/facade page FileAttachment discovery implemented; hosted validation pending
requirements.gaps: CLI/host/viewer annotation selection, activation policy, generic annotation/markup views and icon appearances remain separate work; no file execution, full annotation or profile validation is implied.
requirements.rule: Keep original Annots indexes and resolved annotation/file/payload identities distinct. Require indirect annotation dictionaries and FileAttachment FS/Rect. Normalize geometry, decode Contents without FS/Desc substitution, preserve icon names and apply the PushPin default. Validate shared discovery shape and matching attachment entries under source-located work/result limits. Never decode or activate a payload during discovery.
